name: Omabar
author: Cory Goehring
description: A floating glass bar for Omarchy 4: workspace dots with a water-drop switch, a Spotify mini player with playlists, a split-flap clock with Google Calendar, weather, an ask-anything assistant box, Thunderbird mail, pinned Google Keep notes you can edit in place, a dual-battery meter, AI usage, and a drop-down drawer for system controls. Follows your Omarchy theme.
